hook.text: Checkmate in 4 moves. Beginners fall for this all the time.

step-0.text: Pawn to e4. This opens the door for our queen and bishop.

step-1.text: Black copies us. Totally normal.

step-2.text: Bishop out. It's aiming at f7.

step-3.text: Look at f7. Only the king protects it. That's the weak spot!

step-4.text: Black brings out a knight. Looks fine...

step-5.text: Queen out! Now two pieces attack f7.

step-6.text: Black attacks our queen... But forgets about f7!

step-7.text: Queen takes f7. The bishop protects her. Checkmate!

hook.text: The fastest checkmate in chess. Only 2 moves. Seriously.

step-0.text: White pushes the f-pawn. The king gets weaker.

step-1.text: We open a path for our queen.

step-2.text: Another pawn push. Huge mistake!

step-3.text: Queen to h4. The king is trapped. Checkmate!

hook.text: They have a queen. We have a rook. We still win in 1 move.

step-0.text: Black has a queen. Black is winning... Right?

step-1.text: Look at their king. It's stuck behind its own pawns. No exit!

step-2.text: Black gets greedy and grabs a pawn.

step-3.text: Rook to the back row. The king can't escape. Checkmate!

hook.text: Give away your queen... And checkmate 2 moves later.

step-0.text: Normal start. Our knight attacks e5.

step-1.text: Black protects it with a pawn.

step-2.text: Bishop out. Aiming at f7, the weak spot.

step-3.text: Black pins our knight. 'If it moves, I take your queen!'

step-4.text: We bring out a piece. Black plays a slow move. Now the trap is ready.

step-5.text: Knight takes e5! We leave our queen to die!

step-6.text: Black grabs the queen. Big mistake.

step-8.text: The king has only one square to go.

step-9.text: Knight to d5. Checkmate! Three small pieces beat a queen.

hook.text: This move looks like a blunder... But it ends in checkmate.

step-0.text: Knight to d4. Now e5 looks free...

step-1.text: White takes it. Here we go.

step-2.text: Queen to g5! She hits the knight and g2.

step-3.text: White grabs f7. We grab g2!

step-4.text: The rook runs. Queen takes e4. Check!

step-5.text: Knight to f3. The bishop is pinned. Checkmate!

hook.text: White takes our queen... And gets checkmated right away.

step-0.text: We give a pawn. The Stafford Gambit.

step-1.text: Our bishop aims at f2.

step-2.text: White pins our knight to the queen.

step-3.text: We move it anyway! Take my queen!

step-4.text: White takes it. Bishop takes f2. Check!

hook.text: White takes a free pawn. 6 moves later: Checkmate.

step-0.text: We throw a pawn at them. The Englund Gambit.

step-1.text: White takes and protects it.

step-2.text: Queen to e7. We attack e5 again.

step-3.text: White protects it one more time.

step-4.text: Queen to b4. Check! And she's eyeing b2.

step-5.text: We take b2. Now we attack the rook in the corner.

step-6.text: White attacks our queen. This is the mistake.

step-7.text: Bishop to b4! Their bishop is now pinned.

step-9.text: We take the bishop. Our queen doesn't care.

step-10.text: White takes back... And walks into it.

hook.text: White thinks they won a pawn. Really, they just lost a piece.

step-0.text: White pins our knight. We quietly set the trap.

step-1.text: White grabs d5. 'Your knight is pinned!'

step-2.text: Surprise! We take anyway and give our queen.

step-3.text: White takes it. Bishop check!

step-4.text: Only the queen can block. We take it.

step-5.text: Then the bishop. We're a whole piece up!

hook.text: White takes our bishop. Next move: Checkmate.

step-0.text: We give a pawn. The Budapest Gambit.

step-1.text: Now three pieces hit e5.

step-2.text: White attacks our bishop.

step-3.text: We ignore it and take e5! Leave the bishop.

step-4.text: White takes the free bishop...

step-5.text: The e2 pawn is pinned. The king is boxed in.

hook.text: Promote a pawn to a knight? Yes. And it wins the queen.

step-0.text: We push to d4. White attacks it: Mistake!

step-1.text: Bishop check, then we take e3.

step-2.text: White grabs our bishop. Pawn takes f2. Check!

step-3.text: And it becomes... A knight! With check!

step-4.text: A queen gives no check. The knight does.

step-5.text: White takes it. Bishop check hits the queen.

step-6.text: The king steps back... And we take their queen!

hook.text: Throw your knight as bait... And catch a checkmate.

step-0.text: Knight to g4. It's our fishing pole!

step-1.text: White kicks it. We leave it there.

step-2.text: White bites! Now the h-file is open.

step-3.text: Queen to h4. Threat: Mate on h1!

step-4.text: Pawn to g3. Now nothing stops mate.

step-0.text: The Smith-Morra Gambit. Our queen eyes h2.

step-1.text: Knight to g4. Two pieces hit h2.

step-2.text: White kicks it. Natural... But wrong!

step-3.text: Knight to d4! It attacks the queen.

step-4.text: White takes it... Now nobody guards h2.

hook.text: They want mate in 4. Here's how to stop it.

step-0.text: Normal start. But watch that bishop on c4.

step-1.text: Queen out! Threat: Queen takes f7, checkmate!

step-2.text: Pawn to g6! It kicks the queen away.

step-3.text: The queen comes back. Same threat on f7!

step-4.text: Knight to f6 blocks it. F7 is safe!

step-5.text: Now we attack the bishop. Their queen came out too early.

hook.text: Wrong pawn move means instant mate. Find the safe move.

step-0.text: We pushed the f-pawn. Not great, but not lost.

step-1.text: Black's queen now eyes h4. Our king is open.

step-2.text: Pushing the g-pawn now is checkmate. Don't do it!

step-3.text: Play e4 instead. If the queen checks, g3 blocks.

step-4.text: Bring out pieces. Keep the king safe.

hook.text: A queen up... And you still lose? Not if you play this.

step-0.text: We have a queen. We're winning!

step-1.text: But our king has no exit. Its own pawns block it.

step-2.text: Rook to d8 would be checkmate.

step-3.text: So first: Pawn to h6. Now the king can breathe.

step-4.text: Rook check on the back row...

step-5.text: No problem. The king escapes to h7!

hook.text: They try Lay-gahl's Mate... And just lose their queen.

step-0.text: We pin their knight to the queen.

step-1.text: Here, don't play g6. That's when the trap works.

step-2.text: Knight to f6! It guards d5 and g4.

step-3.text: White tries the trick anyway: Knight takes e5!

step-4.text: This time, take the queen!

step-5.text: Bishop check. King to e7, like before...

step-6.text: Knight check... But that square is covered!

step-7.text: Our knight takes it. No mate. We're a queen up!

step-3.text: Instead, take the knight!

step-4.text: Then castle. We're safe and better.

step-3.text: Knight to c3! Next, our rook hunts the queen.

step-2.text: But knight takes d5 loses a piece! Their knight isn't really pinned.
